items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: When we had our pieces to be taken down in notation, Miss Claim couldn't put them down.

ctx.x: Well, he never played any kind of trombone until years after. You'd have to verify that by the records he supposed to have played with different bands. Edwards was the daddy of all modern trombone players. And nobody could compete with Edwards on the trombone. Although he and I are enemies today. I'll give him what is due. The man was the greatest trombone player of his age. He invented many tricks on the trombone. Which was to be followed by men like Miff Moe. Tea gardens and all of them. Which they improved.…

would have to make up such stuff to fake, like brrrr through a horn. And different other little things that he didn't know the tune would add, different little things, which later became known as jazz licks or jazz idioms. It was just like a fake, a bunch of gypsies, didn't know nothing. And not knowing the tune, we'd fall back on it.
